# Prism Global Services

> Abuja property acquisition, development supervision and management support for Nigerians at home and abroad.

Prism Global Services is an Abuja-based property services team helping Nigerians in the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Ireland, Germany and elsewhere inspect, acquire, build, renovate and manage property in Abuja.

## Core services
- Abuja property search and acquisition support
- Live video and on-site inspections
- Property document and due diligence coordination
- Construction and renovation supervision
- Dated milestone reporting
- Property management for owners abroad

## Verification guidance
Verify property documents, seller authority and the physical site before payment. Retain an independent Nigerian lawyer and relevant surveyor or engineer. Document scope and milestones in writing.
